caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: St. Maarten
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten in the Eastern Caribbean is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 23 kt and seas building to 5.9 ft with E swell at 9s periods. 88% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 23 kt and seas building to 5.2 ft with NNE swell at 6s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
